title: Classify missing canonical Runtime
userIntent: Report readiness for a fresh isolated Controller Home where no canonical Runtime has been started.

intendedBehavior: rh_status classifies the isolated environment as blocked because the Runtime and source snapshot are absent.
behavioralInvariants: Missing Runtime authority is not silently treated as healthy.
regressionRisks: Readiness falsely reports success or loses the actionable reason code.

provenance.note: Shared failure behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
